description: Java class ExampleBuilder for generating API examples from OpenAPI schemas, including handling references, various schema types, and composing examples.

classes.name: ExampleBuilder
classes.description: Utility class for building example objects from OpenAPI schemas, supporting references, nested schemas, and various data types.

methods.name: fromSchema
methods.description: Creates an Example object from a given Schema and definitions map.

methods.name: fromProperty
methods.description: Generates an Example based on a specific property schema, handling references, data types, and nested schemas.

methods.name: alreadyProcessedRefExample
methods.description: Returns a cached Example for a reference if already processed, or creates a default example based on type.

methods.name: mergeTo
methods.description: Merges multiple ObjectExample instances into a single ObjectExample.
